nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Deforestation prevention|Forest regeneration initiatives_qna_000
nodes.question: What is the focus of the Assisted Natural Forest Regeneration project in Zambia?
nodes.answer: The project focuses on managing the natural regeneration of deforested areas by training local farmers in fire management and continuous monitoring to protect these areas.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Deforestation prevention|Forest regeneration initiatives_qna_001
nodes.question: What is the main focus of the assisted natural forest regeneration project in Zambia?
nodes.answer: The project aims to manage the natural regeneration of deforested areas by training local farmers in fire management and continuous monitoring to protect these areas, allowing for natural regrowth.
